python3 - <<'PY'
p='app.mjs'
s=open(p).read().replace('\\n]/.test', '\\r\\n]/.test')
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='app.test.mjs'
s=open(p).read().replace("import {execFileSync}", "import {fileURLToPath} from 'node:url';\nimport {execFileSync}").replace("new URL('./app.mjs', import.meta.url).pathname", "fileURLToPath(new URL('./app.mjs', import.meta.url))")
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
cat >> README.md <<'EOF'

The default (`full`) preserves Unicode and input column order, doubles embedded
quotes, and quotes fields containing commas, quotes, CR, or LF.

Run regression tests with `node --test app.test.mjs`.
EOF
cat > REPORT.md <<'EOF'
# Development results

The default is now `full`: Unicode is preserved and CSV special characters are
escaped without reordering columns. CR-only fields are quoted as well as LF and
CRLF fields. Explicit component configurations remain available.

Validation: `node --test app.test.mjs` passes 4/4 tests, covering default and
explicit full output, column order, Unicode, commas, quotes, line endings, empty
fields, scalar conversion, and component configurations.

The local two-case component study reports: full 2/2, baseline 0/2,
without-unicode 1/2, without-escaping 1/2. These are expected feature comparisons,
not failures of the regression suite. Study scripts and generated output remain
in the ignored local development directory.
EOF
node --test app.test.mjs && node .local/study.mjs --output .local/final-results >/dev/null && git diff --check && git add app.mjs app.test.mjs README.md REPORT.md && git diff --cached --stat && git status --short
